usedFor: Qminder holds queue visitors, and Brevo receives them as contacts through “Add Contacts To List” when a visitor checks in.

bestTemplate.name: “visitor checks in” in Qminder, then “Add Contacts To List” in Brevo
bestTemplate.why: A check-in places the visitor on a chosen Brevo contact list.

watchOut: “Add Contacts To List” adds existing contacts only, so the visitor must already exist in Brevo.
